title: console: one dashboard open fetches the same object's metadata nine times (/meta/object/crm_opportunity ×9 on HotCRM's sales dashboard); team and environment pages repeat /meta reads too
body:
**Finding** (measured on cloud staging, 2026-10-19). Reader: the objectui console / app-shell data layer.

## What was measured

**Setup:**
- Cloud staging after cloud#3071: objectos `8b34956e` serves objectui `47508f3bbb27` over framework `fb9c22aa0929`.
- HotCRM 5.1 environment `os-6hf1jq`, the maintainer's session in the built-in Chromium pane.
- Counted from the page's resource timing entries after one open.

| open | URL repeated in that one open |
|---|---|
| HotCRM 销售业绩 dashboard (`/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/dashboard/sales_dashboard`), full open and in-app open | `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_opportunity` **×9**, 2.1–4.3 s each (21.9 s of request time). Beside it: 18–35 `analytics/dataset/query`. |
| control plane 成员 (`/apps/com.objectstack.cloud/page/team`) | `/meta/object/sys_member`, `/meta/object/sys_organization` and `/meta/object/sys_user` ×2 each |
| control plane 环境 list (`/apps/com.objectstack.cloud/sys_environment`) | `/meta/view` ×3, `/meta/object` ×2, `/data/sys_environment` ×2 (same path; the queries may differ) |
| HotCRM accounts list | two `/security/explain` reads at the end of the open, ~5 s each (compare the closed #8014) |

The dashboard case is not new at this pin. It was measured at objectui `4dfdebdf` too (cloud#2914 comment 6265264751, and the 10-19 baseline).

## Expected

One open asks for one object's metadata once. The widgets of one dashboard that bind the same object share one in-flight read (a request-key cache in the data layer, the shape #13010 and #12980 moved the record page and the console open toward).

## Why it matters

- On a hosted environment, concurrent reads of one environment queue in the tenant runtime (cloud#3053).
- Nine copies of the same metadata read sit in the same wave as the dashboard's analytics queries, and the sales dashboard's full open measured 32.2 s (cloud#2914 comment 6265264751).

## Dedupe

Searched objectui issues, all states:
- `meta/object crm_opportunity dashboard`: 2 hits, #13010 (closed, record page waves) and #4487 (closed, flaky test);
- `per-object metadata fetched repeatedly`: 6 hits, none on this;
- `dashboard widgets object metadata in-flight`: 20 hits, none on this;
- `metadata request dedup`: 20 hits, #8014 (closed, two `/security/explain` per record detail; related to the last row above).
